description: This header file declares a utility class 'nmUtils' within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, providing static methods for networking device property retrieval, interface status checks, security mode handling, and persistent hostname management for the NetworkManager plugin.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static networking functions related to device properties, interface status, security modes, and persistent configuration.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of network devices, implementation not provided in header.

methods.name: wlanIface
methods.description: Returns the wireless LAN interface name.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to a Wi-Fi signal strength.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison between two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode from access point flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Returns the frequency of the Wi-Fi access point.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Returns a string description of security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager log level to trace.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file to disable or enable interfaces.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.
